about: Designer B: every chord sequence from I ii iii IV V V7 vi (one chord per beat) for each vocal bar, in C, F and G major. Bar 0 = L1, bar 2 = L2, bar 5 = beats 2-3 ('diye bagirir'), bar 6 = L4. Measured over the sung frames of that line in all 7 verses. Only the top 40 of each list are stored (2401 / 49 sequences were measured per bar and key). Sorted by J = chord_tone - 2 * (clash_sustained + outside_scale) in note mode, then fewer chord changes, fewer changes on beats 1 / 3, higher on_beat_chord_tone. J_frame / J_early = the same score in frame mode / with chord changes 40 ms early. rules = G1..G4 of 03_tara.py (bar-internal part; the bar 5 -> bar 6 junction is checked when plans are combined); valid = passes G1-G4, valid_turnaround = passes them with G3t instead of G3. Metric definitions: olcum.json.

rules.G1: bar 6 ends on V, V7 or I (task)
rules.G2: the chord right before a bar that is not sung (bars 1, 3, 7, all starting on I) is I, IV, V or V7
rules.G3: V / V7 is followed by V, V7 or I; V7 is not followed by plain V
rules.G3t: second rule set 'turnaround': as G3, but the plain V may step down to IV when that IV goes straight to I (V - IV - I)
rules.G4: every fully sung bar has at least two beats of primary chords (I, IV, V, V7)
rules.ties: J within 0.005: fewer chord changes, fewer changes on beats 1 / 3, higher on-beat chord-tone share, higher J in frame mode
